valores.label: Combined spending of anti-move groups before the 1982 vote (more than)

legenda: Alaska Committee, FRANK, FARE and ARM, combined, per historian David Reamer.
nota: A voz atribui a Reamer, e a tela deve atribuir igual. Os relatórios de campanha de 1982 (fonte primária) não foram abertos.
narracao: Reamer adds that opponents spent more than a million dollars.

conferencia.localizador: parágrafo 'Several organizations formed to oppose the move'
conferencia.prova: "Collectively, the anti-move groups spent over a million dollars in the lead-up to the 1982 election."

fontes.documento: David Reamer, 'One man's pork is another man's pigskin: The 1982 question of whether Alaska should move the capital or buy the NFL' (Histories of Alaska, published Feb. 9, 2026)
